_comment: WHO SAYS EACH GUIDED LINE. One file, read by two packages: the frontend renders
the character and the subtitle from it, and oracle/scripts/pregenerate-guided-voice.ts
reads the same map to decide which enrolled voice synthesises which line.
It is a plain JSON map and not a TypeScript const precisely so the generator can
read it without importing across package boundaries. A character named here must
be one of the four canonical ids; an unknown one fails the generator loudly rather
than silently producing no audio for that step.
THE LINE TEXT ITSELF IS NOT HERE. It lives in the frontend i18n bundles, which is
where the subtitle comes from, so the spoken line and the written line cannot drift
